title: Design-Build for Affordable Housing, Pre-K Classrooms, and Teacher Housing
short_description: Design-build conversion of an existing building into affordable and teacher housing in Kihei.
project_scope: Design, build, finance, operate, and maintain a project on approximately 6.27 gross acres in Kihei, Maui. The project involves converting an existing building into dedicated teacher housing and affordable housing; the project name also references Pre-K classrooms, but no further technical details, floor area, unit count, or classroom program are stated in the source.
services: Design-build-developer services including architecture, civil engineering, and structural engineering, plus financing, operation, and maintenance.
relevance_explanation:
- Building conversion project with no stated structural complexity or long-span/special structural features.
- Scope includes structural engineering, which creates some relevance.
- Primary procurement is design-build/developer with finance, operate, and maintain obligations, reducing direct fit for sbp.
- Affordable housing and teacher housing are generally less aligned with sbp's core focus than bridges, roofs, stadiums, or special structures.
- No evidence of innovative materials, sustainability ambitions, or architecturally demanding structure in the source.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee is stated. Available fee-relevant information: total construction cost is 45,000,000 USD; procurement is design-build-finance-operate-maintain for conversion of an existing building on about 6.27 acres; disciplines include architecture, civil engineering, and structural engineering. A realistic sbp fee cannot be derived from the source alone because the structural scope, service phases, and share of engineering services are not defined.
references_qualifications: Proposals are solicited from qualified individuals and entities for a design-build-finance-operate-maintain project. No specific minimum references or qualification thresholds are stated in the source excerpt.
contracting_authority: Hawaii Housing Finance and Development Corporation (HHFDC), as landowner, together with the County of Maui Department of Housing, as lessee/client side.
